+import os
+import shutil
+
+# Setup a dummy directory for static files
+STATIC_DIR = "test_static"
+if not os.path.exists(STATIC_DIR):
+    os.makedirs(STATIC_DIR)
+with open(os.path.join(STATIC_DIR, "index.html"), "w") as f:
+    f.write("Hello World")
+

+router = APIRouter()
+

+print(f"APIRouter has mount: {hasattr(router, 'mount')}")
+
+# Test mount on app
+app.mount("/static", StaticFiles(directory=STATIC_DIR), name="static")
+print("App mount successful")
+
+# Test mount on router
+router.mount("/router-static", StaticFiles(directory=STATIC_DIR), name="router-static")
+print("Router mount successful")
+
+# Cleanup
+shutil.rmtree(STATIC_DIR)
